traits.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
traits.description: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

multiattack_text: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three with its tail spikes.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

attacks.name: Tail Spike
attacks.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
